SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID as productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME as productName, p.PRODUCT_TYPE as productType, p.PRICE as price, p.DEPOSIT as deposit, p.DESCRIPTION as description, p.IS_AVAILABLE as isAvailable, p.CREATED_AT as createdAt, p.VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, p.CATEGORY_ID as categoryId, c.CATEGORY_NAME as categoryName, p.BRAND_ID as brandId, b.BRAND_NAME as brandName, i.IMG_URL as imgUrl, IFNULL(AVG(r.RATING), 0) as rating, COUNT(r.REVIEW_ID) as rCount FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN REVIEW r ON p.PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND r.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE 1=1
AND p.CATEGORY_ID = #{childCatId}
AND ( p.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} OR p.CATEGORY_ID IN ( SELECT CATEGORY_ID FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORY WHERE PARENT_CATEGORY = #{categoryId} ) )
AND ( p.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR b.BRAND_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
AND p.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'RENTAL'
AND p.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'PURCHASE'
AND 1 = 0
AND p.PRICE >= #{priceMin}
AND p.PRICE <= #{priceMax}
AND p.BRAND_ID IN
#{id}
GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE, p.PRICE, p.DEPOSIT, p.DESCRIPTION, p.IS_AVAILABLE, p.CREATED_AT, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_NAME, p.BRAND_ID, b.BRAND_NAME, i.IMG_URL
ORDER BY p.VIEW_COUNT DESC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
ORDER BY p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
ORDER BY p.PRICE ASC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
ORDER BY p.PRICE DESC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
ORDER BY rating DESC, rCount DESC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
ORDER BY rCount DESC, rating DESC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
ORDER BY p.VIEW_COUNT DESC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
SELECT BRAND_ID as brandId, BRAND_NAME as brandName FROM BRAND ORDER BY BRAND_NAME ASC
SELECT IMG_URL as imgUrl, IS_MAIN as mainImg, SORT_ORDER as sortOrder FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID as productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME as productName, p.PRODUCT_TYPE as productType, p.PRICE as price, p.DEPOSIT as deposit, p.DESCRIPTION as description, p.IS_AVAILABLE as isAvailable, p.CREATED_AT as createdAt, p.CATEGORY_ID as categoryId, p.BRAND_ID as brandId, b.BRAND_NAME as brandName, i.IMG_URL as imgUrl, ( SELECT SUM(ps.AVAILABLE_QTY) FROM PRODUCT_STOCK ps WHERE ps.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID ) AS availableQty, ( SELECT SUM(ps.TOTAL_QTY) FROM PRODUCT_STOCK ps WHERE ps.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID ) AS totalQty FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE p.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, PARENT_CATEGORY AS parentId FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORY WHERE PARENT_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CATEGORY_ID ASC LIMIT 7

SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType, p.PRICE AS price, p.DEPOSIT AS deposit, p.IS_AVAILABLE AS isAvailable, p.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, p.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, p.BRAND_ID AS brandId, b.BRAND_NAME AS brandName, i.IMG_URL AS imgUrl, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.RATING), 1), 0) AS rating, COUNT(r.REVIEW_ID) AS rCount FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN REVIEW r ON p.PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND r.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y' GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE, p.PRICE, p.DEPOSIT, p.IS_AVAILABLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_NAME, p.BRAND_ID, b.BRAND_NAME, i.IMG_URL ORDER BY p.VIEW_COUNT DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID WHERE OI.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND O.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED'

SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType, p.PRICE AS price, p.IS_AVAILABLE AS isAvailable, p.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, p.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, b.BRAND_NAME AS brandName, i.IMG_URL AS imgUrl, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.RATING), 1), 0) AS rating, COUNT(r.REVIEW_ID) AS rCount FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN REVIEW r ON p.PRODUCT_ID = r.PRODUCT_ID AND r.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND p.PRODUCT_ID != #{productId} AND p.IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y' GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE, p.PRICE, p.IS_AVAILABLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_NAME, b.BRAND_NAME, i.IMG_URL ORDER BY p.VIEW_COUNT DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT SPEC_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CAPACITY, SIZE, WEIGHT, MATERIAL, ORIGIN FROM PRODUCT_SPEC WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT FEATURE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, SORT_ORDER FROM PRODUCT_FEATURE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT pog.OPTION_GROUP_ID AS optionGroupId, pog.OPTION_NAME AS optionName, pov.OPTION_VALUE_ID AS optionValueId, pov.OPTION_VALUE AS optionValue, pov.ADD_PRICE AS addPrice, pog.PRODUCT_ID AS productId FROM PRODUCT_OPTION_GROUP pog JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE pov ON pog.OPTION_GROUP_ID = pov.OPTION_GROUP_ID WHERE pog.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY pog.SORT_ORDER ASC, pov.SORT_ORDER ASC, pov.OPTION_VALUE_ID ASC

SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, PARENT_CATEGORY AS parentId FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORY ORDER BY CASE WHEN PARENT_CATEGORY IS NULL THEN CATEGORY_ID ELSE PARENT_CATEGORY END, PARENT_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL, CATEGORY_ID ASC

SELECT poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID AS optionItemId, poi.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, poi.ITEM_NAME AS itemName, poi.EXTRA_PRICE AS extraPrice, poi.IS_AVAILABLE AS isAvailable, IFNULL(ps.TOTAL_QTY, 0) AS totalQty, IFNULL(ps.RESERVED_QTY, 0) AS reservedQty, IFNULL(ps.AVAILABLE_QTY, 0) AS availableQty FROM PRODUCT_OPTION_ITEM poi LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_STOCK ps ON poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID = ps.OPTION_ITEM_ID AND ps.STOCK_DATE = CURDATE() WHERE poi.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID ASC
